title: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c:332 LOG_ERR used at line 332 without logging module - <zephyr/logging/log.h> include and LOG_MODULE_REGISTER are inside #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_ANNOUNCE_SCHEDULER (lines 549, 558), but LOG_ERR usage is outside this block in lichen_announce_ingest_authenticated().
